categories.name: NAND flash
categories.blurb: 3D NAND cells, reliability, page buffers and cache, ferroelectric NAND and multi-level cells.

features.name: Data retention
features.tcad: Add trap-assisted charge loss: enable nonlocal tunneling and trap emission (Sentaurus Device: Traps with Tunneling, nonlocal path) and run a bake-temperature sweep.

features.name: P/E cycling endurance
features.tcad: Model interface/oxide trap generation versus cycles (trap generation rate tied to injected charge) and re-run Vt windows at 1k/3k/10k cycles.

features.name: Program & read disturb
features.tcad: Simulate the unselected string at Vpass/Vread with hot-carrier and FN injection models on, including the neighbouring word lines.

features.name: Cell-to-cell interference
features.tcad: Use a 3-cell (or 5-cell) string structure so charge in neighbours and lateral migration in the shared charge-trap layer is captured.

features.name: Temperature & cross-temperature
features.tcad: Turn on temperature-dependent mobility, trap emission and the poly-Si grain-boundary model, and sweep -40 °C to 125 °C.

features.name: Poly-Si channel grain boundaries
features.tcad: Add discrete grain boundaries with acceptor/donor trap densities in the poly-Si channel (randomised for variability).

features.name: Variability & statistics
features.tcad: Run a statistical (Monte Carlo) set: random dopants, grain-boundary positions and trap counts, then report Vt sigma.

features.name: Layer stacking & scaling
features.tcad: Extend the structure to the target layer count / pitch and check channel-hole taper and word-line resistance effects.

features.name: Cache program / page buffer
features.tcad: Device TCAD does not cover this; co-simulate the cell with a page-buffer netlist (see the circuit step).

features.name: CMOS under array
features.tcad: Add the thermal budget of the array process to the periphery transistors and check their drift.

features.name: Ferroelectric switching
features.tcad: Use a multi-domain ferroelectric model (e.g. Preisach / nucleation-limited switching) instead of a single-domain one.

features.name: ECC, sensing & ML read schemes
features.tcad: Generate Vt distributions from TCAD and feed them to an ECC / read-retry model to report raw bit error rate.

eda.compact_model: Verilog-A charge-trap cell model (Vt shift vs. program pulses, retention and disturb terms) fitted to the paper's data; BSIM4/BSIM-CMG for the select gates and periphery.
tools: Synopsys Sentaurus or Silvaco for TCAD-to-model extraction
steps: Extract a compact cell model from the device data (Vt vs. pulse count, Id-Vg, retention slope) and write it in Verilog-A.
Build a string of 4-8 cells plus select gates and a bit line with its real RC load.
Add a page buffer (sense latch, cache latch) and a simple ISPP program controller.
Simulate program, verify, read and cache-read timing; report tPROG, tR, energy per bit and the read margin.
Re-run with retention / disturb shifts applied to show how the device change affects bit errors.

categories.name: DRAM
categories.blurb: DRAM cells and capacitors, 3D and capacitorless DRAM, retention and row hammer, and HBM.

features.name: Retention & leakage
features.tcad: Turn on band-to-band and trap-assisted tunneling (Hurkx / nonlocal BTBT) at the storage-node junction and compute retention time from leakage.

features.name: GIDL
features.tcad: Enable nonlocal band-to-band tunneling with calibrated parameters and sweep word-line negative bias.

features.name: Row hammer / row press
features.tcad: Simulate two neighbouring cells with transient aggressor word-line toggling and trap capture/emission at the STI and gate edge.

features.name: Variable retention time & traps
features.tcad: Add individual traps with capture/emission time constants near the junction and run a statistical set.

features.name: Temperature
features.tcad: Sweep temperature with temperature-dependent tunneling and SRH lifetimes on.

features.name: Variability
features.tcad: Run Monte Carlo on random dopants, work-function grains and capacitor geometry.

features.name: Capacitor dielectric
features.tcad: Model the capacitor stack with its real permittivity and leakage (Poole-Frenkel / TAT) instead of an ideal capacitor.

features.name: Oxide semiconductor channel (IGZO)
features.tcad: Use a density-of-states (tail + deep states) model for the amorphous oxide channel and its oxygen-vacancy donors.

features.name: Vertical / 3D stacking
features.tcad: Build the vertical or stacked structure in 3D and check floating-body and coupling effects between layers.

features.name: Gain cell (2T0C / 3T)
features.tcad: Co-simulate read and write transistors and the storage node charge in mixed-mode TCAD.

features.name: Sense margin & sensing scheme
features.tcad: Mixed-mode simulation of the cell plus the bit line and a sense amplifier.

eda.compact_model: BSIM4 / BSIM-CMG access transistor (or an RPI / oxide-TFT model for IGZO) plus a leaky storage capacitor, fitted to the paper's I-V and retention data.
tools: CACTI / DRAMsim3 / Ramulator for array and system level
steps: Fit a compact model for the access device and the storage node leakage.
Build a sub-array: cells on a bit line with the real bit-line capacitance, plus a latch-type sense amplifier.
Simulate write, read, restore and refresh; report sense margin, tRCD/tRAS and retention at temperature.
Feed the timing and energy into CACTI or DRAMsim3 to show the system-level benefit.

categories.name: High-power devices
categories.blurb: IGBTs and silicon power MOSFETs, ruggedness and reliability, and power modules.

features.name: Self-heating & thermal
features.tcad: Use the thermodynamic (lattice temperature) model with a realistic heatsink boundary instead of isothermal simulation.

features.name: Breakdown & field termination
features.tcad: Include the edge termination region in the structure and use impact ionisation (e.g. van Overstraeten) for breakdown.

features.name: Short-circuit robustness
features.tcad: Run a mixed-mode short-circuit transient with the thermal model and metal melting limits.

features.name: Avalanche / UIS
features.tcad: Simulate unclamped inductive switching in mixed mode and look for current filamentation.

features.name: Latch-up & parasitic BJT
features.tcad: Model the full cell including the parasitic thyristor path and sweep current density.

features.name: Switching transients & losses
features.tcad: Run mixed-mode double-pulse tests with realistic gate resistance and stray inductance.

features.name: High-temperature operation
features.tcad: Sweep temperature with temperature-dependent lifetime, mobility and impact ionisation.

features.name: Power cycling & lifetime
features.tcad: Couple electro-thermal results to an FEM thermo-mechanical model (e.g. COMSOL / ANSYS) for solder and bond-wire stress.

features.name: Packaging & parasitics
features.tcad: Extract package parasitics (Q3D / FastHenry) and include them in the mixed-mode circuit.

features.name: Gate drive & control
features.tcad: Replace the ideal gate source with a gate driver model in mixed mode.

eda.compact_model: Physics-based IGBT / MOSFET compact model (e.g. Hefner IGBT or a fitted BSIM / MOS level model with thermal network) fitted to the paper's static and switching data.
tools: PLECS or PSIM for converter-level loss and thermal
ANSYS Q3D or COMSOL for package parasitics and thermal
steps: Fit a compact model with a Foster/Cauer thermal network from the paper's I-V, C-V and switching curves.
Build a double-pulse test bench with the measured stray inductance and a real gate driver.
Put the device in a target converter (boost, half-bridge inverter) and compute losses and efficiency over load.
Run a mission-profile thermal simulation to estimate junction temperature swing and lifetime.

categories.name: Wide-bandgap devices
categories.blurb: SiC MOSFETs, GaN HEMTs, vertical GaN, and ultra-wide-bandgap Ga₂O₃, AlN and diamond.

features.name: Self-heating & thermal
features.tcad: Turn on the lattice-temperature model with anisotropic thermal conductivity and the substrate / heat-spreader stack.

features.name: Trapping & current collapse
features.tcad: Add buffer (carbon / iron) and surface donor traps with their energy levels and run transient off-to-on switching.

features.name: Threshold instability (BTI)
features.tcad: Model border/interface traps in the gate oxide (e.g. a two-stage NMP model) and simulate stress/recovery.

features.name: Breakdown & field management
features.tcad: Include field plates / termination and use impact ionisation coefficients for the right polytype and orientation.

features.name: Gate oxide & interface
features.tcad: Add an interface-state density profile (Dit vs. energy) and mobility degradation at the interface.

features.name: High-temperature operation
features.tcad: Sweep temperature with temperature-dependent mobility, polarisation and trap emission.

features.name: Polarisation & 2DEG
features.tcad: Use the strain-dependent piezoelectric polarisation model and check 2DEG density versus barrier thickness.

features.name: Short-circuit & avalanche ruggedness
features.tcad: Run mixed-mode short-circuit / UIS transients with the thermal model on.

features.name: Normally-off (E-mode) gate
features.tcad: Model the p-GaN or recessed gate stack including the Schottky metal / p-GaN junction.

features.name: Monolithic integration & drivers
features.tcad: Simulate two devices on the same substrate to capture back-gating / substrate crosstalk.

features.name: RF / high-frequency
features.tcad: Run AC small-signal simulation to extract fT/fmax including parasitics.

eda.compact_model: ASM-HEMT or MVSG (GaN, CMC standard) / a SiC MOSFET compact model with thermal network, fitted to the paper's I-V, C-V and pulsed data; trapping as an extra sub-circuit.
tools: Cadence Spectre with the ASM-HEMT Verilog-A model
steps: Fit ASM-HEMT / MVSG (GaN) or a SiC MOSFET model to the measured DC, C-V and pulsed I-V; add dynamic Ron with a trap sub-circuit.
Build a double-pulse test bench with realistic layout parasitics and the gate driver the device needs.
Use the device in a target circuit: a totem-pole PFC / LLC / half-bridge inverter for power, or a PA in ADS for RF.
Report efficiency, switching loss, ringing and junction temperature versus Si or SiC baselines.
